Description: 3-dots options menu not showing appropriately on click
Root Cause / Context: Fixed/relative z-index stacking context inside scrollable container and viewport bounds clipping on mobile
Implementation Details: Converted 3-dots menu to fixed backdrop-blurred bottom action sheet on mobile and centered modal with z-50 and e.stopPropagation()
Verification: Verified across mobile and desktop viewports (test_3dots_action_sheet, desktop_snippet_options_modal)

Description: Header navigation items overflowing on mobile screens
Root Cause / Context: Long text labels on navigation buttons ('Snippet Clipper', 'Export/Import', etc.) wrapping onto awkward rows on <640px screens
Implementation Details: Converted header navigation items to compact icon buttons with tooltips, maintaining text only on desktop
Verification: Verified on 390x844 mobile viewport (mobile_compact_icons, mobile_main_view)

Description: Snippet clipper modal exceeding mobile screen height and cutting off controls
Root Cause / Context: Fixed padding, oversized artwork, and rigid modal height without flexible scrollable container
Implementation Details: Implemented compact waveform and scrubber layout, responsive album art thumbnail, scrollable body with sticky footer save controls
Verification: Verified on mobile viewport (mobile_clipper_test, inspect_clipper_mobile)

Description: Login attempt failed with 401 when entering admin/admin
Root Cause / Context: Expected credentials in .env are admin and bitstream4100; browser required refresh before re-authentication
Implementation Details: Used correct credentials (admin / bitstream4100), refreshed page before re-login, verified 200 OK session token issued and stored in localStorage
Verification: Verified in browser subagent (stage_login_and_verify, dashboard_loaded)

Description: Compilation error TS2550: findLastIndex does not exist on type SyncedLyricLine[]
Root Cause / Context: Array.prototype.findLastIndex requires ES2023 target, while tsconfig uses earlier standard library
Implementation Details: Replaced findLastIndex with backwards-compatible iterative reverse search loop (for let i = syncedLyrics.length - 1; i >= 0; i--)
Verification: Verified via npx tsc --noEmit (0 errors) and npm run build (successful)

Description: Compiler error TS2339: Property setMasterVolume does not exist on type AudioEngine
Root Cause / Context: Volume slider in App.tsx called setMasterVolume before method was exposed on AudioEngine class
Implementation Details: Added public setMasterVolume(vol: number) to AudioEngine class adjusting masterGain.gain node
Verification: Verified via npx tsc --noEmit (0 errors) and live audio testing

Description: Create separate Stage environment on port 3100 while keeping Production on port 4100 intact
Root Cause / Context: Need isolated testing ground for major music app improvements without altering working production
Implementation Details: Created stage/ directory with directory junction to node_modules, configured PORT=3100 in stage/.env, isolated stage/snippets-data.json, concurrent background dev servers
Verification: Both servers tested concurrently: http://127.0.0.1:4100 (Prod) and http://127.0.0.1:3100 (Stage)
